elements.label: Figure O.10
elements.description:
Line chart with six panels arranged in a 2x3 grid. Columns are 'No change in Gini', '+1% change in Gini', and '+2% change in Gini'. Top row y-axis: Poverty rate (%, $3.20/day 2011PPP), ticks 0, 2, 4, 6. Bottom row y-axis: Poverty rate (%, $5.50/day 2011PPP), ticks 10, 15, 20. X-axis years 2018, 2020, 2022, 2024. Series: March 2021 growth estimates (grey) and October 2021 growth estimates (orange).

Top row ($3.20/day):
- No change in Gini: March 2021: 6.6 (2018), 5.0 (2020), 4.2 (2021), 3.5 (2022), 3.1 (2023/24 point). October 2021: 4.7 (2021), 4.0 (2022), 3.4 (2023/24 point).
- +1% change in Gini: March 2021: 6.6 (2018), 5.0 (2020), 4.4 (2021), 3.9 (2022), 3.5 (2024 point). October 2021: 4.9 (2021), 4.3 (2022), 3.7 (2024 point).
- +2% change in Gini: March 2021: 6.6 (2018), 5.0 (2020), 4.7 (2021), 4.4 (2022), 4.1 (2024 point). October 2021: 5.2 (2021), 4.9 (2022), 4.6 (2024 point).

Bottom row ($5.50/day):
- No change in Gini: March 2021: 22.4 (2018), 18.8 (2020), 16.9 (2021), 14.9 (2022), 13.2 (2024 point). October 2021: 18.1 (2021), 16.2 (2022), 14.1 (2024 point).
- +1% change in Gini: March 2021: 22.4 (2018), 18.8 (2020), 17.2 (2021), 15.5 (2022), 14.3 (2024 point). October 2021: 18.5 (2021), 17.0 (2022), 15.1 (2024 point).
- +2% change in Gini: March 2021: 22.4 (2018), 18.8 (2020), 17.8 (2021), 16.9 (2022), 15.9 (2024 point). October 2021: 19.2 (2021), 18.2 (2022), 17.0 (2024 point).

Pattern: poverty rates fall over time in all panels; the October 2021 estimates are higher than March 2021 estimates, and higher inequality scenarios produce higher projected poverty rates.
